name: Appalachian State University

athletics.revShareNotes: Sun Belt had 100% opt-in for 2025-26 (Sportico). School-level payout not public; third-party estimate of SBC average ~$2.4M/school at the 22% benchmark (nil-ncaa.com) vs. $20.5M cap.

ratingNotes: FB: 3 straight FCS titles (2005-07) and the 2007 upset at Michigan; FBS since 2014 with four straight SBC titles (2016-19) and a 2022 win at Texas A&M; middling since, Dowell Loggains in his second season (2026). MBB: 2021 NCAA, 2024 SBC regular-season title (Dustin Kerns). Olympic: typical G6 Directors' Cup finish (~150-200). Brand/fans: one of the strongest G6 names, Kidd Brewer routinely full, travels well.
notes: UNC System campus: the chancellor answers to the UNC System president and Board of Governors, and the NC General Assembly has a say. Widely seen as a G6 school with P4/AAC ambitions because of its brand and attendance. Once JMU leaves for the American (2027-07-01), App State is the Sun Belt East's flagship and the most likely next target for the AAC or a P4 conference. "Old Mountain Feud" with Marshall.

notes: Downtown Atlanta campus and Georgia's largest university by headcount (absorbed Perimeter College). The old Turner Field was converted into Center Parc Stadium (2017). Gives any conference an Atlanta-market address, but the TV draw is weak. Governed by the USG Board of Regents.

name: James Madison University

athletics.revShareNotes: Sun Belt had 100% opt-in for 2025-26 (Sportico). AD Matt Roan set a goal of leading the SBC in revenue sharing. About $55M of the department's funding comes from mandatory student fees, which Virginia rules bar from athlete revenue-share pay. Sen. Creigh Deeds' 2026 proposal would let some Virginia FBS schools raise more from fees. JMU is the best-funded SBC department (Cardinal News, Oct 2026).

ratingNotes: FB: FCS champion in 2004 and 2016; strong in the SBC immediately after moving to FBS in 2022 (11-1 in 2023 while bowl-ineligible during the transition); 2025 SBC champion and CFP first-round team (lost at Oregon). Bob Chesney then left for UCLA, so 2026 is a new staff's first season. MBB: 2024 NCAA first-round upset of Wisconsin; Preston Spradlin since 2024. WBB: a perennial mid-major power. Olympic: 1994 field hockey national title and a 2021 softball WCWS run; best Directors' Cup finish in the SBC most years.

headFootballCoach.name: Billy Cosh
headFootballCoach.note: Chesney left for UCLA after the 2025 CFP run; successor recalled as Billy Cosh but not verified.

notes: LEAVING FOR THE AMERICAN. Board of Visitors voted unanimously (2026-10-12) to end Sun Belt membership and apply to the AAC; AAC presidents voted unanimously to admit. A 2026-11-19 agreement moved the exit to 2027-07-01 (originally no later than 2028); JMU stays eligible for every SBC title through 2026-27. Costs: about a $5M SBC exit fee (some reports up to $10M) and about $23M to enter the AAC. 17 of 18 sports move to the AAC; field hockey stays a MAC affiliate. The 2021 FBS move needed approval from Virginia's legislator-led Intercollegiate Athletics Review Commission, and its student-fee-heavy model is a live issue in Richmond. Long-term P4 ambitions, despite Harrisonburg being a tiny TV market.

name: Marshall University

athletics.revShareNotes: Sun Belt had 100% opt-in for 2025-26 (Sportico). School-level payout not public; third-party estimate of SBC average ~$2.4M/school at the 22% benchmark (nil-ncaa.com) vs. $20.5M cap.

ratingNotes: FB: brand built on the 1970 plane crash ("We Are Marshall"); I-AA titles in 1992 and 1996 and a 1990s MAC dynasty (Moss, Pennington, Leftwich). Won the 2024 SBC title under Charles Huff, who then left, and the team skipped its 2024 bowl after mass transfers. Tony Gibson since 2025. MBB: 2018 NCAA win over Wichita State. Olympic: 2020 NCAA men's soccer champion.
notes: President Brad D. Smith is a former Intuit CEO and the school's top donor, so the booster and president are effectively one person. The Friends of Coal Bowl with WVU has been dormant since 2012, and West Virginia politicians periodically push to revive it. The big stadium and brand make Marshall a plausible AAC target alongside App State. Withdrew from the 2024 Independence Bowl (Louisiana Tech replaced it).

name: Old Dominion University

athletics.revShareNotes: Sun Belt had 100% opt-in for 2025-26 (Sportico). School-level payout not public; third-party estimate of SBC average ~$2.4M/school at the 22% benchmark (nil-ncaa.com) vs. $20.5M cap. Like JMU, depends heavily on Virginia student fees.

ratingNotes: FB: football restarted in 2009, went FBS in 2014 (C-USA) and joined the SBC in 2022; 2016 Bahamas Bowl win. Ricky Rahne's 2025 team was strong, and ESPN rated ODU an SBC East contender for 2026. MBB: NCAA trips in 2010 (beat Notre Dame), 2011 and 2019. WBB: historic power with AIAW/NCAA titles in 1979, 1980 and 1985 (Nancy Lieberman era). Olympic: sailing national titles.
notes: Largest Virginia market in the SBC (Hampton Roads). Like JMU, its FBS move needed approval from Virginia's Intercollegiate Athletics Review Commission, and it is funded heavily through student fees. After JMU leaves in 2027, ODU is the SBC's only Virginia school and a natural follow-on target for the AAC.

name: Louisiana Tech University

athletics.revShareNotes: Was in C-USA for 2025-26; C-USA had 100% opt-in (Sportico). Payout not public; likely a low-single-digit-millions figure.

ratingNotes: FB: Terry Bradshaw heritage and Skip Holtz-era bowls (2014-19); Sonny Cumbie since 2022, including the 2024 Independence Bowl as Marshall's fill-in. MBB: Karl Malone legacy and C-USA contender under Talvin Hester. WBB: the "Lady Techsters" brand (1981 AIAW, 1982 and 1988 NCAA titles under Sonja Hogg and Leon Barmore).
notes: Newest member: joined the SBC on 2026-07-01 from C-USA (member 2013-26, WAC 2001-13). It had been an SBC member in 1991-2001. SBC CEOs invited it in 2025 to replace Texas State, which paid a $5M buyout to leave for the Pac-12, and keep the league at 14. Scheduled into Texas State's old West slots (Louisiana, ULM, Southern Miss). President Jim Henderson previously ran the UL System, so Tech joins a three-school UL System bloc in the SBC.
